settings.displayNameHint: Shown in your greeting and on your own messages. Leave empty for a neutral greeting.
settings.title: Settings
settings.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted. Leave blank to keep the current key.
settings.search_api_key_hint: Optional. Search works without a key using the built-in fallback; a Tavily key (free tier at tavily.com) gives better results. Stored encrypted, separate from your LLM key.
settings.api_token_hint: Only needed if your server requires one. Saved in this browser.
settings.language_i18n_note: The interface is being progressively internationalized; some copy is not yet translated.
settings.telemetryDesc: Collect local usage data to improve performance (opt-in)
settings.distill_hint: Learn per-spawn preferences from your feedback when a conversation ends
settings.spawnModeDesc: Choose how sub-agents are created. Auto: instant delegation without checks. Interactive: asks user approval on the fly before spinning up new spawns.
settings.retentionHint: After this many days, a run's actual system prompt / injected knowledge / full tool inputs and raw returns are cleared automatically (scores and timings are unaffected).
settings.headerLore: Models and search, how it looks and what it remembers, and everything that runs on its own.
settings.keyUndecryptableReason: The stored key can't be decrypted. Re-enter it to restore access — see the diagnosis in Search & Tools for what went missing.
settings.strategyHint: Add 2+ models to enable routing strategies
settings.modelStaticFallback: Live model list unavailable — showing built-in list
settings.customBaseUrlRequired: The custom provider requires a Base URL
settings.customCompatNote: Tool calling depends on server flags (vLLM --enable-auto-tool-choice, llama.cpp --jinja); streaming token counts may be missing (shown as ≈); llama.cpp serves a single model.
settings.healthDotNoList: Connected but no model list — doesn't mean unusable; chat may still work
settings.healthDotUnknown: Connectivity not checked yet — click to check
settings.reachableNoListNote: Connected, but no model list was returned — this doesn't mean it's unusable; chat may still work.
settings.orchestratorShellDesc: Let Arslan run whitelisted shell commands. Only Arslan · every command confirmed by risk · off by default.
settings.mcpServerDesc: Let external MCP clients (Claude Code, Codex) call read-only tools. Off by default; requires a generated MCP token. Localhost only.

accessToken.shownHint: Keep this token private — anyone with it can reach this instance.
accessToken.resetError: Couldn't reset — only the local machine can rotate the token.
accessToken.requiredHint: This server requires a token for API and live connections. Paste the token issued for this instance.

settings.evolutionAutoDesc: Let Arslan improve a spawn's prompt on its own, in the background, using replayed past runs.
settings.evolutionAutoSpendWarning: This spends your API credits. There is currently no cap in effect — the limit you can set counts replay dispatches, not tokens. Until you set one, put a hard spend limit in your LLM provider's billing dashboard.
settings.evolutionAutoSpendWarningCapped: This spends your API credits. Attempts projected above {{cap}} replay dispatches are refused. That bounds dispatches, not tokens — the cost per dispatch varies widely, so keep a hard spend limit in your provider's billing dashboard too.
settings.evolutionMaxDispatchesDesc: Refuse an attempt whose projected replay dispatches exceed this. Counts dispatches, not tokens — the cost per dispatch varies too much to cap on. Leave blank for no cap.
settings.embeddingDisabled: Not enabled — add a Zhipu/Qwen/OpenAI key or download the local model to turn on semantic retrieval (keyword search still works).
settings.ocrLanguagesFollowsUi: Following your interface language, plus English. Pick languages to override.
settings.ocrLanguagesCapHint: Up to {{max}}. Asking for more languages makes recognition worse, not better — Chinese and Japanese are lost first.
settings.ocrLanguagesUnavailable: This system has no built-in text recognition, so images are read by your model only.
settings.offlineBody: Settings could not be loaded from the server. What you see are defaults — do not treat them as your real configuration. Saving is disabled until the backend is reachable.
settings.navAutomationHint: Everything that can spend on its own
settings.automationLede: These run in the background and call your model provider, which costs money. They are all off by default and none of them changes anything without you.
settings.curationDesc: While you are idle, Arslan re-reads what it has learned and proposes links and corrections. Proposals land in the second brain's inbox for you to accept or dismiss — nothing is written on its own.
settings.curationSpendNote: This one has no dispatch cap of its own — it is bounded only by how often you are idle.
settings.automationElsewhere: Scheduled tasks and token usage live in Diagnostics, where their history is.
settings.tool_transport_title: Tools will not run on this provider
settings.tool_transport_unsupported: Arslan does not yet pass tool definitions to this provider, so equipped tools and connected MCP servers are never offered to the model and will not be called. Skills still reach the model as instructions, but any step of a skill that relies on calling a tool cannot complete. Choose an OpenAI-compatible provider if you need tools.
settings.tool_transport_unverified: This provider has not been measured against Arslan's tool transport. Tools may or may not be called — nobody has checked yet.
settings.capabilityTableNote: 0–10 ratings used to pick a model for a job. They describe the model's own strengths — not whether Arslan can send tools to that provider on your setup.
settings.cryptoHealthSecretMissing: No ARSLAN_SECRET_KEY is set, so this install is running on the public fallback key and cannot open anything saved earlier. Set ARSLAN_SECRET_KEY to the value used when they were saved.
settings.cryptoHealthRecoverable: An older encryption salt was found that opens these values. Nothing has been changed — recovery has to be started deliberately.
settings.cryptoHealthSaltLost: The per-install encryption salt was missing at startup and a new one was generated, so values saved earlier can no longer be opened. The missing half is the salt, not your secret key — re-entering the key will not bring them back. This usually follows a moved or partly restored data directory.
settings.cryptoHealthMismatch: The secret key and the salt are both present, but neither opens these values: they were saved under a different ARSLAN_SECRET_KEY.
settings.placeholderSearchKey: Paste a key to upgrade from the built-in search
settings.labelGithubToken: GitHub token (optional — raises the discovery rate limit)
settings.searxngVerdictUnreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the URL, and that the instance is running and reachable from this machine.
settings.searxngVerdictNotSearxng: Something answered, but it is not a SearXNG. Check the port — another service may be on it.
settings.searxngVerdictJsonDisabled: This is a SearXNG, but it will not return JSON. Add `json` to `search.formats` in its settings.yml and restart it.
settings.modelRolesLede: Which model handles which task. Leave a slot unset and that task keeps working exactly as it does now.
settings.slotPurposeCompaction: Summarises older messages when a conversation grows long, so it can keep going.
settings.slotPurposeTitle: Writes the short name a conversation gets in the sidebar.
settings.slotPurposeSynthesis: Turns the findings gathered by tools into the finished answer.
settings.slotPurposeVision: Reads images you attach. Applies only on turns that actually carry an image — every other turn is untouched.
settings.slotPurposeRouter: Decides how an incoming request is handled before any answer is written.
settings.slotFallbackPinnedPrimary: Unset: always uses your main config ({model}).
settings.slotFallbackRouted: Unset: assigned by your routing strategy.
settings.slotFallbackFollowsConversation: Unset: uses whichever model the conversation is already running on.
settings.modelRolesEmbeddingPointer: The embedding model is set under Memory & Data.

inbox.title: Evolution inbox
inbox.spawn_hint: Evolution runs as a background job — estimate the cost, enqueue, then review the proposal under Diagnostics · Evolution.
inbox.confirm_title: This will re-run the same data
inbox.confirm_body: Nothing new has been recorded since attempt #{{id}}, which failed on “{{reason}}”. Running now replays the identical corpus, so the result is very likely to be identical too.
inbox.confirm_cost: It would still run up to {{dispatches}} replay dispatches.
inbox.outcome_failed: Attempt #{{id}} did not beat the baseline ({{reason}}).
inbox.outcome_skipped_budget: Attempt #{{id}} was refused before spending anything: {{reason}}
inbox.outcome_skipped_structural: Attempt #{{id}} could not be evaluated yet: {{reason}}
inbox.watch_lost: Attempt #{{id}} is still running; this panel stopped following it. Reopen to check.
inbox.empty_desc: Evolution rewrites a spawn's prompt from its own scored runs, then parks the rewrite here for you to accept or reject. Nothing is ever applied without you.

diag.title: Why no proposals yet
diag.pick_spawn: Select a spawn above to see its evolution eligibility.
diag.verdict_in_flight_hung: An attempt (#{{attempt_id}}) has been running for {{age_min}} min and never finished — the runner may be stuck.
diag.verdict_drought_no_runs: No scored runs yet — this spawn needs real usage before it can evolve.
diag.verdict_drought_non_replayable: {{non_replayable}}/{{total_scored}} scored runs aren't hermetically replayable, leaving only {{replayable}} (< {{min}}).
diag.verdict_baseline_flooring: The declared baseline floors the corpus to {{scored_ge_baseline}} runs (< {{min}}).
diag.verdict_holdout_via_synthetic_topup: The real holdout has {{real_holdout}} pairs; the next evolve tops it up to {{min}} with synthetic tasks — enqueue to run.
diag.verdict_gate_failure: The last attempt (#{{attempt_id}}) failed the gate: {{reason}}.
diag.verdict_skipped_budget: The last attempt (#{{attempt_id}}) was skipped for budget: {{reason}}.
diag.verdict_eligible_looking: Corpus and backoff look ready — the optimizer may just not have beaten the baseline yet, or evolution hasn't been enqueued.
